scope: Independent read-only review of interface documentation, current successful-source workload, conditional performance estimates, and existing generated-RTL evidence. This is not new hardware verification or acceptance of a complete numerical RTL implementation.

open_hardware_findings.summary: QK and AV generated task RTL have no successful numeric path after valid context.
open_hardware_findings.details: The issue wrappers map QK to full_run_task_33 and AV to full_run_task_35. In each final generated task, context status 0 selects fixed E_SHAPE (3) and elements 0; otherwise the context error is propagated. The 3-5 cycle HLS task latency therefore cannot be used as successful attention latency. The current artifacts cannot be accepted as a complete successful numerical forward implementation.
open_hardware_findings.root_cause: Not established. Current C++ and the retained precheck IR contain the numerical paths; this review does not attribute the final constant rejection to a specific C++ condition or compiler defect.
open_hardware_findings.required_followup: Follow-up repair and validation must establish successful numerical paths, then re-evaluate resources, timing and performance. No repair or hardware execution was performed during this documentation review.

independent_checks: All 124 summarized weight descriptors match the original model manifest fields.

All three observed-count objects match their raw CPU metadata. The reconstructed CSV contains 74,948 rows and its per-op counts match the observed B1/B1/B2 counts; it is not a recorded per-task timing trace.
For every reconstructed LIN_* row, recomputed rows*K*N and rows*N*(K/32) against its original weight shape; all scenario totals and 160/179/199 multiplications match.

Directly checked q8_linear_compute.cpp row/column/group/k serialization and compute_one HLS XML: no pipeline; inner trip 32, latency 160; group iteration 179-199; whole-function latency undefined. Group range already includes the inner dot.
Checked controller issue completion dependency and all-S attention work before mask application. Source contract includes 28 Encoder layers, 2 Decision layers, 16-marker scorer and 1-row ACT.
Checked 615 source/report SHA256 references in initial evidence, then final evidence_index hashes for all 10 artifacts. Checked new anomaly RTL hashes and precise branch/element lines.

Independently parsed 311 representative internal RTL ports and every representative module declaration count; directions and widths match logical_module_interfaces.json. Additional ports cited by final documentation table were directly checked.
Verified top 13 AXI masters have 32-bit data and 64-bit addresses, while internal byte channels and RAM handshakes are distinguished from external bus ports.
Verified LN, embedding, quantizer, GEGLU and FP_ACT loop factors against HLS evidence; source-workload formulas are not promoted to whole-task timing measurements.
Verified model BO total 448,923,648 bytes and current host per-invocation upload/working-buffer initialization; LOAD_W declared 392,448,128 bytes excludes separately read bias.
Verified two inclusive mapped compute_one instances each use 6 DSP; reviewed no-overlap and no-double-counting interpretation rather than inferring MAC/cycle from DSP count.

Reviewed final central report and current navigation/status banners in 35 companion documents. Source contract, generated interfaces, static failure, conditional estimates, historical OOC scope, and unexecuted stages are distinguished.

recomputed_workload.validity: Conditional successful full source-graph workload with unchanged serial Q8 leaf schedule at an assumed 150 MHz. Not measured end-to-end latency, not a bound for the current RTL request that can exit with error, and not a finite whole-network worst-case bound.

review_corrections_resolved: LOAD_W declared bytes corrected to exclude separately read bias.
Minute-scale Q8 figures re-scoped to conditional successful source-graph execution; no current successful RTL latency claim.
QK and AV constant-error static evidence included prominently and independently distinguished from synthesis success.
Logical function contracts separated from actual generated internal/external ports; historical parallel architecture budgets labeled as unimplemented.
Arbitrary 10%/25% extra-cost scenarios removed from final report.
README CPU/FPGA division row explicitly labels the FPGA responsibility as the source/deployment contract and records the confirmed QK/AV E_SHAPE failure.
limitations: No full RTL cosimulation, Vivado/HLS rerun, P&R, platform link, GPU benchmark, board run or new performance measurement in this review.
Exact cause and repair scope of QK/AV synthesis anomaly remain unknown; other numerical RTL paths were not exhaustively proven.
No independent RoPE numeric leaf was identified; absence of a standalone leaf name alone is not proof of a failure, and complete RoPE path verification remains open.
AXI useful-byte efficiency, bursts, stalls, shared-port concurrency, complete traffic and end-to-end cycle counts remain unmeasured.
The 150 MHz conversion is a requested clock approximation, not achieved board frequency.
Repairs that retain additional arithmetic or change schedules invalidate affected resource and performance extrapolations and require renewed checks.
